defipunkd.summary: Fluid DEX is a decentralized exchange built by Instadapp (rebranded from Instadapp in late 2024) on top of the Fluid Liquidity Layer — a unified liquidity primitive shared across lending, vaulting, and DEX protocols. Users swap tokens through DEX pools (type T1) deployed via CREATE opcode and identified by integer dexId; a DexLite variant offers a simplified single-contract swap interface. The protocol's key innovation is that vault collateral and debt positions simultaneously serve as DEX liquidity, maximising capital efficiency across all three protocol types.

details.name: Control
details.description: Not yet assessed — Who holds admin privileges, how contracts can be upgraded, and how quickly. No automated heuristic grades this at Phase 0; a real assessment arrives when onchain discovery reads roles, owners, and timelocks.

details.name: Ability to exit
details.description: Not yet assessed — Whether users can exit on their own terms if the team disappears or acts adversarially. Requires per-protocol review; not available at Phase 0.

details.name: Autonomy
details.description: No Phase-0 autonomy signal — Neither the category heuristic nor the forkedFrom signal fires for this protocol. A real autonomy graph (oracles, bridges, fallbacks, governance-mutable dependencies) arrives with Phase-2 onchain discovery.

details.name: Open Access
details.description: Not yet assessed — Whether the protocol depends on privileged operators, whitelists, geo-restrictions, or off-chain infrastructure. This is not a signal DeFiLlama carries in a usable form; crawler-based detection lands in a later phase.

details.name: Verifiability
details.description: Open source + 8 audits — Protocol publishes a GitHub repository and has at least one audit on record. This is a coarse Phase-0 signal only: auditor reputation, scope, and post-audit review coverage are not yet weighted.

pigi.summary: Fluid (Instadapp) — unified liquidity layer / lending / DEX / vaults ($1.01B, Ethereum-led)

details.name: Node rating
details.description: pigi’s own rating of fluid itself, 0–100, higher = safer. Its rubric covers audits and bounty, admin and pause authority, operational history and scale. Rated 2026-09-14, methodology 1.14.0. Weight in the score: 0.6.

details.name: Vault score, TVL-weighted
details.description: The mean of pigi’s latest scores of the 3 rated Ethereum vault(s) that deposit into fluid, weighted by their 30-day average TVL ($251.9M in all). Weight in the score: 0.4. Vaults by band: A 0, B 0, C 2, D 0, F 1.

details.name: Weights
details.description: pigi’s fixed formula: score = 0.6 × node rating + 0.4 × vault score. With no rated vault the node rating stands alone.

pigi.note: Headline: fluid. Vault score counts Ethereum vaults only.

text: score = 0.6 × the protocol node's own rating + 0.4 × the TVL-weighted mean (weight = tvl_30d_ma share) of the latest published score of every rated vault that deposits into it; with no rated vault the node rating stands alone (applied.k1 = 1). The band is read straight off the thresholds, without the dwell rule that smooths vault bands, so it can move on any day. A vault that deposits into more than one protocol node (every Morpho vault: the framework and the Blue instance) counts toward each. Vault scores are the published ones — their caps were computed against the node rating as of their own date, so after a node re-rate the two terms agree again at the next nightly. chain_id narrows the vault set only.
